subject: Media Literacy
title: Conscious Consumption
description: A micro-lesson that makes Conscious Consumption usable.

hook.text: You bought something you saw advertised. A week later you forgot you owned it. It's still in the box.

buildup.text: Conscious consumption means pausing before purchases to ask whether a need is real or manufactured.

discovery.text: The 24-hour rule — waiting a day before any non-essential purchase — eliminates most impulse buying.

twist.text: Advertising's entire purpose is to override that pause. Every technique exists to prevent you from thinking.

climax.text: The most powerful ad defense is a simple question: did I want this before I saw the ad?

punchline.text: If the desire started with the ad, so should the skepticism.

quiz.question: What is the 24-hour rule for purchases?
options: Wait a day before non-essential purchases to avoid impulse buying
Only shop for 24 hours a month
